It is that a snake is going inside a shoe in a Masjid where I make my salah. And the snake is going out after sometime and I am wearing it without checking the shoes. And it is a black hard snake. And the thing is that it is not my shoe it is my colleague's shoe. Is there any reason for this to occur consecutively or it is just a dream. Answer ID: 40755 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1425/907/L=1433) Ask your friend to safeguard his nafs and offer salah and recite the holy Quran regularly otherwise he may fall prey of nafs and satan which might throw him away from religion.
